validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed 15 browser cases across all three engines: six per-plot geometry/restoration cases, six documented-example control cases and three original example autofit regressions. Fill and overlay pixels, unchanged data, exact formatted units and byte-identical restored screenshots pass at desktop and 390-pixel widths. The right axis expands when an extreme enters view and contracts when it leaves. The actual built website passed 60 states across desktop and mobile layouts, including all nine controls, with no page, console or example errors, badge overlap or overflow. Final engine, autofit and built-site screenshots were inspected. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.website: 63 static pages built successfully; per-plot example verified through initial state and all nine controls at desktop and mobile widths in all three engines
validation.budgetChange: Per-plot assignment, validation and transaction safeguards add 0.75 kB to the base bundle (108.12 to 108.87) and 0.68 KiB to chart-only imports (67.31 to 67.99). Workspace persistence measures 6.30 kB versus 6.09 kB. Limits are now 109 kB base, 117 kB base plus trade, 246.5 kB terminal, 6.5 kB workspace, 287 kB all tiers and 68.25 KiB chart-only. All optional-tier removal checks pass.
validation.review: Independent review and failing regressions covered outer saved-map accessors, nonenumerable fields, empty-map compatibility, callback reentry, range callback failures, interrupted legend formatting and unintended formatter writes. Screenshot inspection found stale percent formatting after restoring a price plot; explicit price formats now restore the chart formatter. Exact restored screenshots match in all three engines. Axis metadata and copy ownership in indicator templates remain explicitly tracked.
